title: Fasting Window Completion by Weekday
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:fasting
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(completed="true")) as successful by _time weekday
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for fasting windows by weekday.
value: Completion by weekday helps separate schedule-related misses from motivation issues.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for fasting windows events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for fasting windows by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often fasting windows works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
